title: Implement PostgreSQL schema introspection queries
description: Implement the SQL queries and backend logic to introspect PostgreSQL schema: tables, columns, data types, primary keys, foreign keys, unique constraints, and indexes.
acceptanceCriteria: SQL queries retrieve tables and columns from PostgreSQL

evidence: commit:7149982 - TASK-056: fix introspection test expectations and pg.Client mock
